export function escaped() {
	try { action(); }
	// observability: swallowed because the resource is already closed
	catch (error) {}
	try { action();
		// observability: swallowed because the cache is optional
	} catch (error) {}
	try { action(); }
	// observability: swallowed because
	catch (error) {} // expect: catches.unobserved
	try { action(); }
	// observability: swallowed because the resource is already closed

	catch (error) {} // expect: catches.unobserved
	try { action(); } catch (error) { // expect: catches.unobserved
		// observability: swallowed because this is inside the handler
	}
	try { action(); }
	/* // observability: swallowed because a block comment is not the escape */
	catch (error) {} // expect: catches.unobserved
	try { action(); } /*
	// observability: swallowed because this is inside a block comment
	*/ catch (error) {} // expect: catches.unobserved
	try { const text = `
// observability: swallowed because this is template text
`; } catch (error) {} // expect: catches.unobserved
}

// observability: swallowed because the background request is best effort
request.catch(() => {});
// observability: swallowed because   whitespace before the reason is harmless
request.catch(() => undefined);
request
	// observability: swallowed because the background request is best effort
	.catch(() => undefined);
// observability: swallowed because
request.catch(() => {}); // expect: catches.promise
// observability: swallowed because this applies to only the outer handler
request.catch(() => {
	request.catch(() => {}); // expect: catches.promise
});

const discard = () => undefined;
// observability: swallowed because the background request is best effort
request.catch(discard);
